key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. Tank size is the starting size for the Chunk fit until it learns its own. The plugin never changes it; each fit's learned size is shown below it.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected %, Remaining, DTE and Tank size. DTE is Remaining times Torque's long-term mpg. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If a Wrong vehicle profile? notification appears, choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. Tank size is the starting size for the Chunk fit until it learns its own. The plugin never changes it; each fit's learned size is shown below it.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected %, Remaining, DTE and Tank size. DTE is Remaining times Torque's long-term mpg. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If a Wrong vehicle profile? notification appears, choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Hitri začetek
 1. Namestite Torque Pro (plačljivo različico; Torque Lite ne podpira vtičnikov) in seznanite adapter OBD-II.
 2. Omogočite ta vtičnik v Torque → Nastavitve → Vtičniki.
 3. Dovolite obvestila in nastavite porabo baterije na Neomejeno, da lahko Torque zažene ta vtičnik v ozadju.
 4. V Torque izberite profil vozila, ki ga vozite. Podatki se hranijo po profilu Torque in preverijo glede na identiteto VIN/ECU vozila.
 5. Pri novem profilu se vir goriva zazna ob povezavi; če ste pozvani, ga primerjajte s kazalnikom na armaturi in tapnite Potrdi. Potrdi je na strani nastavitve in v obvestilu. Izberete ga lahko tudi spodaj.
 6. Velikost rezervoarja je začetna velikost za prileganje Chunk, dokler se ne nauči svoje. Vtičnik je nikoli ne spremeni; naučena velikost vsakega prileganja je prikazana pod njim.
 7. V Torque dodajte kazalnike za [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level in za vsako prileganje Corrected %, Remaining, DTE ter Tank size. DTE je Remaining krat dolgoročni mpg iz Torque. Obvestilo med ponovnim prileganjem pove, da prileganje bere 1:1, dokler se ponovno prileganje ne konča.
 8. Vrnite raven goriva v Torque: Izklopljeno, zglajeno ali popravljeno iz prileganja Chunk, Band ali Kalman na kazalnik 012F.
 9. Gorivo se šteje samo, ko motor teče. Vtičnik teče samo, ko je Torque povezan z ECU.
 10. Nadaljujte z vožnjo in točenjem; natančnost raste čez več delnih rezervoarjev. Če se pojavi obvestilo Napačen profil vozila?, izberite, kaj storiti s to vožnjo.
 11. Vsi podatki ostanejo v tem telefonu. GPS in lokacija se ne zapisujeta.

key: Feed fuel level back to Torque (overrides 012F)
source: Feed fuel level back to Torque (overrides 012F)

key: Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.
source: Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.
text: Zagon iz baterije ali v ozadju je bil zavrnjen. Odprite enkrat, da lahko vtičnik deluje s Torque.

key: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
text: Po potrebi dodajte dodatne rezervoarje (serijski rezervoar 1 vedno ostane). Ne preklopite tipal na pin PCM FLI (lažno točenje). Vsak dodatni rezervoar potrebuje lasten dodatni PID v Torque (MCU Mode 22, edinstveno ime — ne 012F ali Ford 16C1). Vrednost Select-PID je identifikator rezervoarja od 1. Gal/hr se bremeni samo aktivnemu rezervoarju.

key: Tank size is the starting size for the Chunk fit until it learns its own. The plugin never changes it; each fit's learned size is shown below it.
source: Tank size is the starting size for the Chunk fit until it learns its own. The plugin never changes it; each fit's learned size is shown below it.
text: Velikost rezervoarja je začetna velikost za prileganje Chunk, dokler se ne nauči svoje. Vtičnik je nikoli ne spremeni; naučena velikost vsakega prileganja je prikazana pod njim.

key: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
source: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
text: Zapiše vrednost na serijski Fuel Level (012F) v Torque, da jo obstoječi kazalniki pokažejo: Izklopljeno, zglajeno ali popravljeno iz prileganja Chunk, Band ali Kalman. Prileganje, ki še ni zgrajeno, zapiše zglajeno raven.

key: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
source: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
text: Potreben je Torque Pro (plačljiv). Torque Lite ne podpira vtičnikov.

key: The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.
source: The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.
text: Ime tega profila vozila. Vsak profil vozila v Torque dobi lasten profil vtičnika, podatke in naučene karte.

key: Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.
source: Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.
text: Znamka vozila (npr. Ford). Služi le izbiri, katere PID goriva znamke lahko zaznavanje preizkusi.

key: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
source: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
text: Od kod prihaja surova raven goriva. Zaznaj (ECU mora biti povezan) preizkusi kandidate samo za branje in prosi za potrditev, če se dva vira ne ujemata. Potrdi je na strani nastavitve in v obvestilu. Noben = zaznaj ob naslednji povezavi.

key: Only for the source "Torque extra PID by long name": the exact long name of the Torque PID that reports the level.
source: Only for the source "Torque extra PID by long name": the exact long name of the Torque PID that reports the level.
text: Samo za vir »Dodatni PID Torque po dolgem imenu«: natančno dolgo ime PID v Torque, ki sporoča raven.

key: blank = no starting size; each fit learns its own.
source: blank = no starting size; each fit learns its own.
text: prazno = ni začetne velikosti; vsako prileganje se nauči svoje.

key: Time constant of the smoothing filter (0 = no smoothing).
source: Time constant of the smoothing filter (0 = no smoothing).
text: Časovna konstanta filtra glajenja (0 = brez glajenja).

key: Largest change per second the smoothed level may follow; slosh beyond this is ignored.
source: Largest change per second the smoothed level may follow; slosh beyond this is ignored.
text: Največja sprememba na sekundo, ki ji zglajena raven sme slediti; večje pljuskanje se prezre.

key: Rise in level while stopped that counts as a fill.
source: Rise in level while stopped that counts as a fill.
text: Dvig ravni med mirovanjem, ki šteje kot točenje.

key: Optional: enter the odometer reading and Save pin to anchor distance for this profile.
source: Optional: enter the odometer reading and Save pin to anchor distance for this profile.
text: Neobvezno: vnesite odčitek števca in Shrani sidro, da zasidrate razdaljo tega profila.

key: Which tank the fuel burn (gal/hr) is charged to. From PID: a Torque PID chooses it (1-based tank id).
source: Which tank the fuel burn (gal/hr) is charged to. From PID: a Torque PID chooses it (1-based tank id).
text: Rezervoar, ki se mu bremeni poraba (gal/hr). Iz PID: PID v Torque ga izbere (identifikator od 1).

key: Only when Active tank = From PID: the long name of the Torque PID whose value is the tank id.
source: Only when Active tank = From PID: the long name of the Torque PID whose value is the tank id.
text: Samo ko je Dejavni rezervoar = Iz PID: dolgo ime PID v Torque, katerega vrednost je identifikator rezervoarja.

key: Tank %1$d custom long name (e.g. [FuelSmooth] Tank%1$d Level)
source: Tank %1$d custom long name (e.g. [FuelSmooth] Tank%1$d Level)
text: Dolgo ime po meri rezervoarja %1$d (npr. [FuelSmooth] Tank%1$d Level)

key: Torque extra PID by long name
source: Torque extra PID by long name
text: Dodatni PID Torque po dolgem imenu

key: Fuel Smoothing is refitting a map for %1$s. That fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
source: Fuel Smoothing is refitting a map for %1$s. That fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
text: Fuel Smoothing ponovno prilega karto za %1$s. To prileganje bere 1:1, dokler se ponovno prileganje ne konča.

key: Fuel Smoothing has no fuel level source for %1$s. Open the setup page and tap Detect, or pick a source.
source: Fuel Smoothing has no fuel level source for %1$s. Open the setup page and tap Detect, or pick a source.
text: Fuel Smoothing nima vira ravni goriva za %1$s. Odprite stran nastavitve in tapnite Zaznaj ali izberite vir.
Na tej vožnji ni ravni goriva

key: %1$s gave no usable level for %2$s. Check the adapter connection, or run Detect on the setup page.
source: %1$s gave no usable level for %2$s. Check the adapter connection, or run Detect on the setup page.
text: %1$s ni dal uporabne ravni za %2$s. Preverite povezavo adapterja ali zaženite Zaznaj na strani nastavitve.

key: Open Fuel Smoothing setup and pick a source (or add the PID in Torque), then tap Detect.
source: Open Fuel Smoothing setup and pick a source (or add the PID in Torque), then tap Detect.
text: Odprite nastavitev Fuel Smoothing in izberite vir (ali dodajte PID v Torque), nato tapnite Zaznaj.

key: Detected %1$s reading %2$.0f %% for %3$s. Check it matches the dash fuel gauge, then tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification (%4$s).
source: Detected %1$s reading %2$.0f %% for %3$s. Check it matches the dash fuel gauge, then tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification (%4$s).
text: Zaznano %1$s, odčitek %2$.0f %% za %3$s. Preverite, da se ujema s kazalnikom na armaturi, nato tapnite Potrdi. Potrdi je na strani nastavitve in v obvestilu (%4$s).

key: Detected %1$s for %2$s. Check it matches the dash fuel gauge, then tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification (%3$s).
source: Detected %1$s for %2$s. Check it matches the dash fuel gauge, then tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification (%3$s).
text: Zaznano %1$s za %2$s. Preverite, da se ujema s kazalnikom na armaturi, nato tapnite Potrdi. Potrdi je na strani nastavitve in v obvestilu (%3$s).

key: This vehicle is %1$s (%2$s), but Torque's profile is '%3$s'. Data goes to %1$s; tap to open Torque and switch profiles.
source: This vehicle is %1$s (%2$s), but Torque's profile is '%3$s'. Data goes to %1$s; tap to open Torque and switch profiles.
text: To vozilo je %1$s (%2$s), profil Torque pa je »%3$s«. Podatki gredo v %1$s; tapnite, da odprete Torque in preklopite profil.

key: Torque profile '%1$s' doesn't match this vehicle (%2$s). Suggested: %3$s. Data is held and discarded at drive end unless you keep it.
source: Torque profile '%1$s' doesn't match this vehicle (%2$s). Suggested: %3$s. Data is held and discarded at drive end unless you keep it.
text: Profil Torque »%1$s« ne ustreza temu vozilu (%2$s). Predlog: %3$s. Podatki se zadržijo in ob koncu vožnje zavržejo, če jih ne obdržite.

key: This drive will be saved to %1$s. Torque's plugin API can't create or switch Torque profiles: in Torque, create/select a vehicle profile named '%2$s'.
source: This drive will be saved to %1$s. Torque's plugin API can't create or switch Torque profiles: in Torque, create/select a vehicle profile named '%2$s'.
text: Ta vožnja bo shranjena v %1$s. API vtičnika Torque ne more ustvariti ali preklopiti profilov Torque: v Torque ustvarite ali izberite profil vozila z imenom »%2$s«.
